status: pre-registered before any engine code or run; not to be edited after the first scored run
hypothesis: H1 Serviceability. Averaging committed and basic Enrich categories over the lookback, excluding own-account transfers, debt repayments and one-off outflows above $5,000, will derive monthly living expenses within 15% of the true figure for applicants who share all their transaction accounts, with at least 3 months of history, because recurring living costs dominate monthly outflows once transfers and one-offs are removed.
metric: absolute percentage error of derived against true monthly living expenses, where living expenses are committed plus basic (AF-E1, AF-E3; the GLE's observed component). Scored with the SIG-13 harness, expense_truth = committed_plus_basic (ground truth expenses.committed_monthly + expenses.basic_monthly)

classification.supported: primary run share within 15% >= 0.85, with the negative control passing
classification.refuted: primary run share within 15% < 0.70, with the negative control passing
classification.inconclusive: 0.70 <= share < 0.85, or the negative control fails, or the data cannot test the claim

data.population_primary: fully covered: every account the applicant holds is in the grant (ground truth coverage.unshared_account_ids is empty), with 3 months of history or more
data.population_secondary: applicants with at least one account not in the grant; error recorded, no target

categorisation.source: Moroku Enrich local engine (moroku-enrich/packages/engine), no dictionary, overrides or LLM cache loaded, as in SIG-12 T3
categorisation.note: the ticket's control is taxonomy 1.3; only the local engine at taxonomy 1.4 is available (the deployed Enrich over the private network, D27, is not built). The engine version and taxonomy are recorded in each run record
categorisation.cache: every debit in set v1 is categorised once and stored as research/enrich/synthetic-v1-categories.json, keyed by transaction id, so the tests run in CI without Enrich

group_mapping.basis: AF-E1's groups, mapped to Enrich category names before any run
group_mapping.also_excluded: any debit whose narrative carries a BSB and account number (own-account transfer, as in SIG-39 EQ-02)
group_mapping.unmapped_category: counted as discretionary and reported, so it never inflates GLE silently

method.debits_considered: negative amounts in every shared account inside the lookback window ending on as_of
method.one_offs: a single debit in a committed or basic category above the one-off threshold is excluded from the average and listed for review (AF-E2)
method.average: total per group divided by the months covered: days from the first transaction in the window to as_of, over 30.4375

negative_control.name: rotated categories
negative_control.manipulation: within each applicant, every debit takes the category of the next debit in transaction order (the last takes the first's), keeping the amounts, dates and the mix of categories but breaking which spend has which category
negative_control.expected: share within 15% below 0.30; if it is 0.30 or more, the categories are not what drives the result and no other result in the set stands

known_limits: set v1's expense truth is the expected value of each generated item (mean amount x cadence factor); realised spending varies around it, and annual or quarterly items may or may not fall in the window
the categoriser is the local engine at taxonomy 1.4, not the deployed Enrich at 1.3
income, liabilities and flags are not derived by this engine; their metrics in these run records are not results
